يحتسبا (form VIII)
# يَحْتَسِبَا (yaḥtasibā) /jaħ.ta.si.baː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَسَبَ (iḥtasaba)
# يُحْتَسَبَا (yuḥtasabā) /juħ.ta.sa.baː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَسَبَ (iḥtasaba)
